description: Post-lowering AST conformance for the mom6_cgrid pressure-gradient rule pair (grids/mom6_cgrid/rules/mom6_cgrid_diff_x/y.esm, with the face-thickness averages mom6_cgrid_avg_u/v.esm) at N_I = N_J = 8, N_K = 3 — the traced stage-2 subdomain of the EqESM MOM6 momentum lane. Pins the canonical expanded bytes of the finite-volume pressure-gradient force chain of PressureForce_FV_Bouss (MOM_PressureForce_FV.F90:1795-1813): the forward-difference face groups dP_x = -diff_x(P_int) + diff_x(h)*intx_pa - diff_x(e_bot)*intx_dpa*Z_to_H (and the dP_y mirror) built from the east/north face forward differences with their explicit mirrored 0 wall regions at i = N_I / j = N_J, and the face accelerations PFu = 2*I_Rho0*IdxCu*dP_x/(2*avg_u(h) + h_neglect) (and the PFv mirror) over the avg_u/avg_v face-thickness averages with their mirrored wall regions; the numeric correctness is verified against the Fortran by the stage-2 mom6_momentum pins (EqESM stage2/mom6_momentum.esm).
